title: Some deception doesn’t attack the church.
paragraphs:
Some deception doesn’t attack the church.
It joins it.

Jesus warned that false teachers would not look dangerous.
They would look familiar… spiritual… convincing.

“Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.”
— Matthew 7:15

Not every voice quoting Scripture speaks truth.
Not every preacher pointing to God leads to Christ.

Some wolves wear the language of faith.
But their message slowly replaces truth with comfort.
A real shepherd leads people to repentance, holiness, and obedience to Christ.
A wolf leads people to compromise, pride, and a gospel without the cross.

The question is not:
Does it sound Christian?

The real question is:
Does it align with the words of Jesus?

⚠️ Discernment is not judgmental.
It is obedience.

Question:
What signs help you recognize a wolf in sheep’s clothing today?
